title: Verification Note: Prairie Wire "10-Mile Zone" Bulletin

fields.desk: Calder County EOC, Situation Unit verification desk
fields.item: Prairie Wire bulletin BIRDFLU-MINNESOTA (LARKIN, Minn.): "Federal tests confirm bird flu at a Calder County turkey farm. Officials have closed roads in a 10-mile zone, according to a county situation report obtained by Prairie Wire." The desk asks the county to confirm "10 miles" and the farm count by 08:30.
fields.checkedBy: EOC Situation Unit, logged on CCEM-LOG-04

checks.check: Board of Animal Health duty veterinarian call to the Director, 07:50
checks.result: The national reference laboratory in Ames confirmed HPAI H5 on the IP-1 samples at 07:44. The Board's figures stand: 1 premises, 62,000 birds, 10 km control area, 11 checkpoints. The bulletin's 'federal tests confirm' line matches.

checks.check: Board quarantine order and control-area publication (Tuesday night)
checks.result: Infected zone 3 km, buffer zone 7 km, 10 km control area. 'Federal planning values; the Minnesota plan governs.' No mileage figure appears anywhere in the Board's text.

checks.check: Source of the bulletin's 'county situation report'
checks.result: County SITREP #4, CCEM-LOG-04, issued 06:00 today, reads 'control area 10 miles'. The wording matches the bulletin. 10 km is about 6.2 miles; 10 miles is about 16 km. SITREP #4 is still in distribution with the mileage figure.
Says 'about 6 miles'. This is a conversion of the Board's 10 km, not a Board figure. It is a third version of the same number now in circulation.

Not supported. The 11 checkpoint sites control traffic at the control-area boundary. Movements under Board permit continue (feed, rendering and finished-bird requests are open at the permit desk). No road closure order has been issued for the control area.
Board: 1 infected premises. The bulletin names no farm. The Board's public name for IP-1 is a code name; no owner or farm name has been released.

fields.reasoning: The federal confirmation in the bulletin is accurate, but the '10-mile zone' traces to a unit error in the county's own SITREP #4: the Board's control area is 10 km, about 6.2 miles. The 'closed roads' wording also conflicts with checkpoints that are passing permitted traffic.
fields.nextStep: Prairie Wire reply is due by 08:30. As of this note, the Board's public information officer has not been contacted about the bulletin. SITREP #4 still carries the 10-mile figure, and the cooperative's buyers and export broker are waiting for a state number.

instructorNote: Pressure inject on keeping one set of numbers: the county's own SITREP caused the wire error. Watch that the PIO calls the Board PIO before replying, gives only the Board's figures (10 km, planning value, Minnesota plan governs) with no farm name, that the Director logs the 07:44 confirmation and issues a corrected SITREP #4 with a correction note, and that PROD gives the distributor and broker the Board's published counts and distances now. Also hand the PIO the Extension Educator's text asking what to tell the fair board's 60 swap-meet vendors and the 190 small-flock owners: the Board says no poultry swap meets this Saturday inside the control area.
